author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a gentle rocking beat, high and low, loud and soft, stop and go, and calming down together with a lullaby.

classes.title: Rock in the cradle
classes.goal: Hear the whole lullaby and rock slowly to its beat, cuddled together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a slow swing that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Cuddle your child on your lap and rock slowly side to side with the song.
classes.childAction: Rock slowly, like a baby in a cradle.
classes.bridge: The beat rocks like a cradle on a branch: swing, and swing back.

intro.caption: Listen and sway
intro.parentCue: Cuddle your child and rock slowly, like a cradle

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and rocking slowly together.

classes.title: Rock, rock, tap
classes.goal: Tap one gentle tap on every beat while the grown-up plays the lullaby.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once on each beat, gently.
classes.bridge: Each tap is one push of the cradle: soft, slow and even.

intro.caption: Tap on every beat
intro.parentCue: Tap softly on your child's shoulder first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one gentle tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs up to the treetop and floats down

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and stretch up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear: tap the left side. Bird: tap the right side.
classes.bridge: The bear sleeps under the tree on the left; the bird sits on top.

intro.caption: Here comes the bear, here comes the bird
intro.parentCue: Point left for bear, right for bird

games.caption: Up to the treetop
games.parentCue: Lift your child's hand up as the tune climbs

games.caption: Bird on the treetop
games.parentCue: Chirp softly, then tap the right side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Windy taps, sleepy taps
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Blow like the wind for loud taps; whisper 'shh' for soft sleepy taps.
classes.childAction: Loud: big windy taps. Soft: tiny sleepy taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are the wind in the tree; soft taps are a sleeping baby.

intro.caption: Windy taps, sleepy taps
intro.parentCue: Loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle and bunny lullaby
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Rock slowly with the slow music, bounce quickly with the fast, then rock again.
classes.childAction: Slow music: slow taps. Fast music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are a turtle going to bed; fast taps are a bunny hopping.

intro.caption: Slow taps, fast taps
intro.parentCue: End on slow, so your child settles

games.caption: Bunny rocks the cradle
games.parentCue: Quick and light, then slow down again

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Shh, baby is sleeping
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: When the music stops, freeze and whisper 'shh'; smile when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while music plays. Freeze like a sleeping baby when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the cradle rocks; music off, the baby sleeps still.

intro.caption: Go! Tap the beat
intro.parentCue: When the music stops, freeze and whisper shh

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Rock the baby together
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps a gentle beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune softly and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap a soft beat on any key while your grown-up plays.
classes.bridge: The tune is the cradle; your soft beat is the gentle rocking.

intro.caption: Play it together
intro.parentCue: Sit close, and play the tune softly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, softly.

classes.title: Lullaby for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole lullaby from the first note to the last, then tuck teddy in.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play softly, then tuck teddy in and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap a soft beat to the end, then tuck teddy in.
classes.bridge: The lullaby rocks teddy from the first note to the sleepy last one.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Put teddy in front, ready for a lullaby

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a whole song, start to end, calmly.
